description: Localization (i18n) file for Select2 version 4.0.6-rc.1, providing Ukrainian translations for UI messages.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns message indicating failure to load results.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns message indicating input is too long, suggesting deletion of excess characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns message indicating input is too short, prompting user to enter more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns message indicating maximum number of selections has been reached.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns message indicating no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns message indicating a search is in progress.
